comments.author: ksenkowski
comments.message: Thoughts about adding phpmyadmin to this since that is one of the key reasons for using MAMP/LAMP/WAMP?

replies.author: LanyonM
replies.message:
That's a good suggestion - but it seems the answer isn't as quick as adding a couple Chef community cookbooks. It looks like the community phpmyadmin cookbook relies on a fork of the php cookbook, and I don't want to go there.

Generally speaking it's good to know the software before you automate it, so I'll have to read up on how phpmyadmin gets installed, so I can keep the wp-shell based solely on community cookbooks.
